title: What If You Stood on Phobos? A Fast Throw Escapes Forever

scenes.text: What if you stood on Phobos? Throw a ball hard enough and it never comes back.
Phobos is a lumpy rock only about 11 kilometers in radius, orbiting Mars.
Its gravity is tiny, less than a thousandth of what you feel on Earth.
Escape velocity is only about 11 meters a second, around 41 kilometers an hour.
A fast pitch or a sprinter's top speed beats that, so a hard throw leaves for good.
And the rock is doomed. Within roughly 30 to 50 million years, Mars will tear it into a ring.
